summary_1line: As Khara marches to attack Rama, terrifying omens appear, but he arrogantly dismisses them and drives his titan army toward battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: A rain of blood falls from dark elephant-like clouds as Khara’s chariot advances beneath a dimmed sun while vultures circle overhead.
A grim vulture perches on Khara’s golden battle standard while jackals with flaming jaws howl before the marching titan army.
Khara stands roaring in his chariot with bow raised as the sky darkens unnaturally and comets streak across the trembling earth.
